description: Symfony is a PHP framework built from reusable components. These lessons use its routes, requests and response objects. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Create a Symfony 7 skeleton project with Composer and install the Symfony CLI. Save each example as src/Controller/LessonController.php. Use the default attribute route import. Run symfony server:start --no-tls --port=8000.
versionNote: Examples use Symfony 7 with PHP 8.2 or later.
whatYouWillLearn: Make a controller route with Symfony
Generate a named URL with Symfony
learningObjectives: Make a controller route with Symfony
Constrain a path number with Symfony
Send an error status with Symfony
